note: Soft line break (<a:br/>) within a text paragraph, not a new paragraph. Add to a shape, nested group shape, or materialized slide placeholder; omitting /paragraph[K] targets the last paragraph. Placeholder X is a 1-based placeholder ordinal or a type/alias such as title, body/content, subtitle, date, footer, slidenum, object, picture, or centerTitle. Unlike the C# implementation, a placeholder inherited only from the layout is not materialized by this command.
